body:
Everything we wear absorbs energy—from the gemstones in our rings and bracelets to the metals that hold them. Just like you need rest to replenish your energy, your jewelry and crystals need a place to release, reset, and recharge. This Selenite Charging Dish is designed to do just that.

Selenite is one of the few crystals that never needs cleansing—instead, it actively purifies everything it touches. Whether you place your rings, necklaces, bracelets, or small tumbled stones inside, this dish works as an energetic reset button, clearing negativity, amplifying intentions, and restoring everything to its highest frequency.

Why You Need This Dish

  • Jewelry & Metal Cleansing – It’s not just gemstones that hold energy—metals absorb vibrations too. Rest your jewelry in this dish at the end of each day to clear away energetic buildup.

  • Crystal Charging & Amplification – Place small crystals in the dish to restore their natural frequency and keep their energy aligned with your intentions.

  • Daily Energy Reset – Keep this dish on your bedside table or vanity to give your favorite pieces an overnight energetic refresh.

  • Minimalist & Functional – With its sleek, polished design, this dish is as beautiful as it is powerful, making it a perfect addition to any sacred space.
